purpose: Independent practice of C4 step 4 (reflect and refine).
student_learning_goal: I can check my prediction against what really happens and adjust the model.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can check my prediction against what really happens and adjust the model.
header.character_watermark: Maple the Maple Tree in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Compare 4 predict-vs-actual scenarios. Note the gap (how far off the prediction was).
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four predict-vs-actual rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four comparison rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each row has columns 'Predict | Actual | Gap'. Pre-filled: row 1 (5, 4, ___), row 2 (8, 8, ___), row 3 (10, 12, ___), row 4 (6, 5, ___). Header 'Predict vs Actual:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_COMPARE: keywords (predict, actual) name what the rows ask for.

parts.answer_key: Row 1 gap: 1 less. Row 2 gap: 0 (matched). Row 3 gap: 2 more. Row 4 gap: 1 less.

parts.student_instructions: Each rule below was a bit off. Refine the rule based on the data.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three rule-refining boxes.

image_placeholders.description: Three refining boxes in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each box has 'Old rule: ___' and 'Refined rule: ___'. Pre-filled old rules: '1 tree = 1 bucket (but 1 was dry)', '24 kids share 60 crackers (but 1 absent)', '7 days = 7 books (but missed Friday)'. Header 'Refine the Rule:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_REFINE: keywords (refine, rule) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: Row 1: 4 of 5 trees give 1 bucket. Row 2: 23 kids share 60 crackers. Row 3: 6 days = 6 books.

parts.student_instructions: Think of a real-life prediction you made. Did it match? How would you refine it?
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A drawing or writing box with reflection lines.

image_placeholders.description: A blank drawing or writing area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in, with 3 reflection lines. Header 'My Real-Life Refinement:'. Lines: 'I predicted: ___', 'Actual: ___', 'I would refine to: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_MY_REFINE: keywords (my, refinement) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Child reflects on a real-life prediction and offers a refinement.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, invent another scenario and refine its rule.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet practices C4 step 4 (reflect and refine). Watch for the wrong-vs-imperfect framing — children may say 'I was wrong' instead of 'my model needs refining'.
